permission.watchdog_owner: FPGA useful accepted control-cycle progress; independent TPS3431 removes hardware permission on progress loss
permission.watchdog_wdi_rule: No free-running timer, ESP heartbeat or network activity may service it; bound repetition/accepted sequence in endpoint
permission.watchdog_wdi_implementation: Not exposed by current reference RTL; additional gateware/board integration required
permission.rtl_watchdog_source: gateware/rtl/cnc_endpoint.v WATCHDOG_CYCLES at fpga.clock_hz; implemented accepted-progress timeout in the reference endpoint
permission.external_watchdog_status: TPS3431 supervisory study value; simulation study only; select timing capacitor/tolerance and machine stop contract
permission.fault: Latch disarmed; output permission removed; fresh verified state and explicit rearm required
permission.tx: drive G low with /G high; field pair high-Z; active STEP0 before permit release; do not claim glitch-free transitions without test
permission.field: gate14commands on LOGIC side before isolation; ISO7740F defaults low;14switch-input external pulldowns; no ESP gating
permission.analog: DAC zero request; separate spindle run off; physical zero clamp still missing
permission.safety_boundary: operational stop only; machine protective circuit/STO/brakes external and machine-specific

power_protection.topology: Physical DC-rated entry fuse in each CORE and FIELD supply, then coordinated electronic protection; branch devices where useful. High-side output ICs already provide channel protection.
power_protection.efuse_family_candidate: TPS2663; exact ordering variant and MODE configuration unresolved
power_protection.efuse_mode: Latched off for FIELD; recovery does not rearm actuators. Firmware cannot bypass current/voltage limits.
power_protection.reverse_polarity: TPS2663 requires external reverse-polarity FET implementation; not credited as built-in complete reverse protection
coordination_open: minimum and maximum prospective fault current
power_protection.not_claimed: A generic eFuse is not an emergency-stop or an independently qualified protective circuit; fuse amp rating alone does not prove clearing.

support_decisions: Three local TPS62160 converters are provisioned now: FPGA1.2V, FPGA/I/O3.3V and independent ESP3.3V. Earlier priced two-piece basket is incomplete.
Keep only one TLV76050 candidate in the analog domain. FIELD5V needs a switching regulator pending thermal design; earlier second LDO is not accepted.
ISO1212 already integrates input isolation; do not add another22input isolator channels.
ISO7740 all4channels travel one direction. Four command chips plus one reversed chip provide16commands+4faults; one additional chip serves analogSPI/inhibit.
T20F256 requires external configuration storage/programming plan; Q100F3 embedded-flash claims do not apply.
No 90W adapter or monitor supply compatibility conclusion until monitor exactinput/power, startup surge and converter losses are measured. Field outputs use external power.
